apps: JSON map which contains apps configuration.
cookie_encryption: BASE64-encoded key used to encrypt session cookies. Generate with `head -c32 /dev/urandom | base64`. Changing it signs every user out.
debugging.api_delay: Add delay to API responses (for debugging purposes).
dialect: Database engine Semaphore stores its data in.
dirs.repos: Path to directory where repositories are stored.
dirs.secrets: Path to directory where secrets are stored (for example Vault token files). Default: `/tmp/semaphore`. Legacy top-level `secrets_path` is still accepted when `dirs.secrets` is unset or left at the default.
dirs.ssh_agent_sockets: Path to directory where SSH agent sockets are stored. Default: /tmp/semaphore
email_password: Password used to authenticate against the SMTP server.
email_secure: Enable StartTLS to upgrade an unencrypted SMTP connection to a secure, encrypted one.
email_tls: Use SSL or TLS connection for communication with the SMTP server.
email_tls_min_version: Minimum TLS version to use for the connection.
env_vars: JSON map which contains environment variables exposed to task runs.
forwarded_env_vars: JSON array of host environment variables which will be forwarded into task runs.
git_client: Implementation used to clone repositories: `cmd_git` shells out to the installed `git`, `go_git` uses the built-in Go library.
gotify_token: Application token issued by the Gotify server.
ha.redis.addr: Address of the Redis server used for HA. Example: `localhost:6379`.
ha.redis.tls: Enable TLS for the Redis connection.
ha.redis.tls_skip_verify: Skip TLS certificate verification for the Redis connection.
jwt.default_ttl: Default lifetime of an issued task JWT, as a Go duration (e.g. `30m`, `1h`). Default: 1h
jwt.issuer: Value emitted in the `iss` claim of issued JWTs.
jwt.max_ttl: Hard upper bound on per-template JWT TTL, as a Go duration. Default: 24h
ldap_binddn: The distinguished name (DN) used to bind to the LDAP server for authentication.
ldap_bindpassword: Password of the bind account used to search the directory.
ldap_mappings.cn: LDAP attribute to use as the common name (CN) mapping for user authentication.
ldap_mappings.dn: LDAP attribute to use as the distinguished name (DN) mapping for user authentication.
ldap_mappings.mail: LDAP attribute to use as the email address mapping for user authentication.
ldap_mappings.uid: LDAP attribute to use as the user ID (UID) mapping for user authentication.
ldap_needtls: Flag to enable or disable TLS for LDAP connections.
ldap_searchdn: The base distinguished name (DN) used for searching users in the LDAP directory (e.g., dc=example,dc=org).
ldap_searchfilter: The filter used to search for users in the LDAP directory (e.g., (&(objectClass=inetOrgPerson)(uid=%s))).
ldap_server: The hostname and port of the LDAP server (e.g., ldap-server.com:1389).
max_task_duration_sec: Max duration of a task in seconds.
max_tasks_per_template: Maximum number of recent tasks stored in the database for each template.
metrics.enabled: Serve the Prometheus metrics endpoint. See [Metrics](/admin-guide/metrics).
metrics.password: Password for HTTP basic auth on the metrics endpoint.
metrics.username: Username for HTTP basic auth on the metrics endpoint. Leave empty to serve it unauthenticated.
mfa.totp.app_name: Issuer label (Semaphore title) shown in TOTP authenticator apps.
mysql.name: MySQL database (schema) name.
mysql.options: Extra driver options appended to the DSN, as a JSON object of name/value pairs.
non_admin_can_create_project: Allow non-admin users to create projects.
postgres.name: Postgres database (schema) name.
postgres.options: Extra driver options appended to the connection string, as a JSON object of name/value pairs. Use it for `sslmode`, for example.
process.gid: ID for group under which wrapped processes (such as Ansible, Terraform, or OpenTofu) will run.
process.no_new_privs: Set the `no_new_privs` flag so wrapped processes cannot gain new privileges.
process.uid: ID of user under which wrapped processes (such as Ansible, Terraform, or OpenTofu) will run.
process.user: User under which wrapped processes (such as Ansible, Terraform, or OpenTofu) will run.
rocketchat_url: The rocketchat webhook url. Semaphore will used it to POST Rocket.Chat formatted json alerts to the provided url. Available since v2.9.56.
runner.executor: The whole executor block as one JSON value, for deployments that configure the runner entirely through environment variables. Equivalent to setting the nested `runner.executor.*` keys.
runner.executor.type: Strategy the runner uses to execute each task: `local` (default), `k8s` or `docker`.
runner.max_parallel_tasks: Max number of parallel tasks for the runner. Default: 9999.
runner.name: Runner name.
runner.project_id: Restrict the runner to a single project.
runner.registration_token_file: Path to file containing the runner registration token.
runner.token: Authentication token this runner presents to the server. Issued by `semaphore runner register`.
runner.token_file: Path to token file for runner registration.
runners.default_global_runners_mode: What projects do with global runners by default: empty leaves the choice to each project, `disable` excludes them, `prefer` uses them ahead of project runners, `require` allows only them.
schedule.timezone: Timezone used for scheduling tasks and cron jobs. Default: UTC
slack_url: The slack webhook url. Semaphore will used it to POST Slack formatted json alerts to the provided url.
sqlite.host: Path to the SQLite database file.
sqlite.name: Accepted for the shared database schema but not used for the SQLite file path. Set sqlite.host instead.
sqlite.options: Extra driver options appended to the DSN, as a JSON object of name/value pairs.
sqlite.pass: Unused for SQLite. The database is a file and needs no credentials.
sqlite.user: Unused for SQLite. The database is a file and needs no credentials.
ssh.strict_host_key_checking: Host key policy for git over SSH: `no` accepts any key, `yes` requires the key to be in the known_hosts file already, `accept-new` pins the key on first connection and rejects later changes.
syslog.address: Hostname and port of the Syslog server. Example: `localhost:514`.
syslog.enabled: Enable or disable writing logs to the configured syslog server.
syslog.format: Format of the Syslog messages. Can be `rfc5424` or empty for default.
syslog.network: Protocol used to connect to the Syslog server: `udp` or `tcp`.
syslog.tag: The tag used to mark Semaphore UI records on the Syslog server.
telegram_chat: Set to the Chat ID for the chat to send alerts to. Read more in [Telegram Notifications Setup](/admin-guide/notifications/telegram#chat-id)
tls.enabled: Enable or disable TLS (HTTPS) for secure communication with the Semaphore server.
tls.http_redirect_addr: Address (`host[:port]`) for the HTTP→HTTPS redirect listener. Mutually exclusive with `tls.http_redirect_port`.
tls.http_redirect_port: Port to redirect HTTP traffic to HTTPS. Mutually exclusive with `tls.http_redirect_addr`.
apps.<id>.priority: Numeric ordering priority. At application discovery, zero or negative values use built-in priorities for ansible (1000), terraform (900), terragrunt (850), tofu (800), bash (700), powershell (600) and python (500). Other application IDs retain their configured value, or zero when omitted.
apps.<id>.title: Display name of the application in template forms.
apps.<id>.icon: Icon identifier displayed for the application.
apps.<id>.color: Application icon color for the light theme.
apps.<id>.dark_color: Application icon color for the dark theme.
apps.<id>.path: Executable path for this application on the execution host. The executable and its dependencies must be installed there.
apps.<id>.args: Array of command arguments supplied to this application. Use separate strings for separate arguments; keep secrets out of arguments.
global_credential_providers.<id>.url: Required Vault/OpenBao base URL. HTTPS is required except for loopback addresses; credentials must not appear in the URL.
global_credential_providers.<id>.namespa: Optional Vault namespace sent with provider requests; empty selects the default namespace.
global_credential_providers.<id>.ca_cert: Optional PEM-encoded CA certificate content for provider TLS verification (not a filename).
global_credential_providers.<id>.timeout: Request timeout as a Go duration. Empty uses `5s`; values must be positive and at most `30s`.
global_credential_providers.<id>.max_res: Maximum provider response size in bytes. Zero uses 1048576 (1 MiB); accepted range is 1 through 4194304 (4 MiB).
global_credential_providers.<id>.auth_me: Authentication method: `token` (empty-value default), `approle`, or `kubernetes`. Bootstrap material comes from the derived credential environment variable, never this object.
global_credential_providers.<id>.auth_mo: Authentication mount name. Empty uses `approle` for AppRole or `kubernetes` for Kubernetes authentication; unused for token authentication.
global_credential_providers.<id>.role_id: Required AppRole role ID when auth_method is `approle`. The Secret ID is supplied separately via the credential environment variable.
global_credential_providers.<id>.role: Required provider role name when auth_method is `kubernetes`.
oidc_providers.<id>.client_id: OAuth client ID registered with the identity provider. A configured client_id_file takes precedence.
oidc_providers.<id>.client_id_file: File containing the OAuth client ID, read from the configured secrets directory. Overrides client_id.
oidc_providers.<id>.client_secret: OAuth client secret; prefer client_secret_file to keep secret material outside the main configuration. Never commit this value.
oidc_providers.<id>.client_secret_file: File containing the OAuth client secret, read from the configured secrets directory. Overrides client_secret.
oidc_providers.<id>.redirect_url: Callback URL registered at the identity provider, for example `https://semaphore.example.org/api/auth/oidc/company/redirect` for provider ID `company`.
oidc_providers.<id>.scopes: Requested OAuth scopes. Empty uses `["openid", "profile", "email"]`; add the provider-specific scope needed for group claims.
oidc_providers.<id>.display_name: Label of the provider on the login page.
oidc_providers.<id>.provider_url: OIDC issuer URL used for discovery. Use discovery when supported; otherwise configure endpoint fields.
oidc_providers.<id>.endpoint.issuer: Issuer URL for manually configured OIDC endpoints; must match the token issuer.
oidc_providers.<id>.endpoint.auth: OAuth authorization endpoint used to start sign-in when discovery is not configured.
oidc_providers.<id>.endpoint.token: OAuth token endpoint for exchanging the authorization code.
oidc_providers.<id>.endpoint.userinfo: OIDC user-info endpoint for manually configured providers.
oidc_providers.<id>.endpoint.jwks: JWKS endpoint used to verify provider token signatures.
oidc_providers.<id>.endpoint.algorithms: Allowed provider signing algorithms for manual OIDC configuration, such as `["RS256"]`.
oidc_providers.<id>.name_claim: Claim containing the display name. Default: `preferred_username`.
oidc_providers.<id>.email_claim: Claim containing the email address. Default: `email`.
oidc_providers.<id>.group_claim_missing_: Behavior when the configured group claim is absent: `preserve` retains existing mapped roles; `clear` removes mapped roles. Default: `preserve`.
oidc_providers.<id>.order: Numeric order of this provider on the login page.
ldap_providers.<id>.display_name: Legacy LDAP provider display name. Managed LDAP providers are configured separately in the database.
ldap_providers.<id>.server: LDAP hostname and port, for example `ldap.example.org:636`.
ldap_providers.<id>.bind_dn: Distinguished name of the LDAP account used to search for users.
ldap_providers.<id>.bind_password: Password of the LDAP search account. Secret: keep it out of version control.
ldap_providers.<id>.search_dn: Base distinguished name under which users are searched.
ldap_providers.<id>.search_filter: LDAP user search filter with `%s` for the escaped login name, for example `(uid=%s)`.
ldap_providers.<id>.mappings.dn: LDAP attribute containing the distinguished name; defaults to `dn`.
ldap_providers.<id>.mappings.mail: LDAP attribute containing email; defaults to `mail`.
ldap_providers.<id>.mappings.uid: LDAP attribute containing username; defaults to `uid`.
ldap_providers.<id>.mappings.cn: LDAP attribute containing display name; defaults to `cn`.
ldap_providers.<id>.icon: Legacy LDAP login button icon identifier.
ldap_providers.<id>.order: Numeric legacy provider order; ties are sorted by provider ID.
port: HTTP listening port, with or without a leading colon, for example `:3000`. Combined with interface for the bind address.
interface: Listening IP address. Empty binds on all interfaces; use `127.0.0.1` for a local reverse proxy.
web_host: Public base URL including any path prefix, for example `https://semaphore.example.org`. Used for externally visible links and redirects.
cookie_hash: Base64-encoded session-cookie authentication key. Generate once and keep it stable across restarts and identical on HA nodes.
home_dir_mode: Task HOME handling: `project_home` uses the project temp directory; `template_dir` and `user_home` preserve the process HOME. Only `template_dir` additionally sets ANSIBLE_HOME to the per-template `_home/.ansible` directory, separate from the repository checkout. Default: `template_dir`.
access_key_encryption: Legacy base64-encoded key for encrypting stored access keys. For rotation, use encryption.keys_file and its keys/active fields. Keep every key needed to decrypt retained database records.
